BiblicalUsage: The word tsôwʼ carries the sense of soiled, defiled. In Zechariah 3:3, Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and it appears again in Zechariah 3:4.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that God put tsôwʼ exactly where it is, and I trust His placing of it.
